title.value: Consistency Guaranteed Causal Graph Recovery with Large Language Models

abstract.value: Causal graph recovery traditionally relies on statistical estimation of observable variables or individual knowledge, which suffer from data collection biases and knowledge limitations of individuals. Leveraging the broad knowledge in scientific corpus, we propose a novel method for causal graph recovery to deduce causal relationships with the large language models (LLMs) as a knowledge extractor. Our method extracts associational relationships among variables and further eliminates the inconsistent relationship to recover a causal graph using the constraint-based causal discovery methods. Comparing to other LLM-based methods that directly instruct LLMs to do highly complex causal reasoning, our method shows advantages on causal graph quality on benchmark datasets. More importantly, as causal graphs may evolve when new research results emerge, our method shows sensitivity to new evidence in the literature and can provide useful information to update causal graphs accordingly.
